pages.text:
Dual Wielding System
                 |
                 |Dual wielding allows fighters to wield two weapons simultaneously
                 |for increased offensive capability.
                 |
                 |How It Works:
                 |  - Equip a primary weapon with 'wield' or 'wear'
                 |  - Equip a secondary weapon with 'second' or 'offhand'
                 |  - Your secondary weapon must be significantly lighter than your
                 |    primary (no more than 50% of primary weight)
                 |  - In combat, you get attacks with both weapons
                 |
                 |Dual Wield Skill:
                 |  - Improves through practice when successfully attacking with
                 |    your secondary weapon
                 |  - Higher skill = higher chance of secondary weapon attacks
                 |  - Heavily affected by Dexterity and learned combat experience
                 |  - Slowing effects reduce your dual wield chance
                 |
                 |Restrictions:
                 |  - Cannot use a shield while dual-wielding
                 |  - Cannot hold or wield other items while dual-wielding
                 |  - Secondary weapon must be appropriate weapon type  
                 |
                 |Combat Mechanics:
                 |  Round sequence:
                 |  1. Primary weapon attack
                 |  2. Secondary weapon attack (if skill check passes)
                 |  3. Extra attacks from spells/skills (Haste, Second Attack, etc.)
                 |
                 |Typical Weapons for Off-Hand:
                 |  - Dagger, Short Sword, Axe, Scimitar
                 |  - Avoid heavy two-handed weapons
                 |  - Avoid very light weapons (backstabs use primary)
                 |
                 |See also: second, wield, wear, skills
